verdict.rationale: Plugin marketplaces (which can host skills) explicitly document 'version tracking, automatic updates' and installation via `/plugin install` and `/plugin marketplace add`, giving a documented update path for skills distributed as plugins. However, this update mechanism applies to the plugin/marketplace layer, not to skills installed directly (e.g., via manual SKILL.md drop-in or Skills API upload), and there's no explicit 'update' command shown for standalone skills or API-managed skills. missing for 10: an explicit update/upgrade command demonstrated in a walkthrough, confirmation that marketplace auto-update applies uniformly to skill-only installs (not just plugins), and independent/community confirmation that updates work smoothly in practice.
